$comment: Machine-readable spec for composing this template in Railway's template composer. Mirrors services/*.env.template. Not an official Railway schema — use it as the source of truth when clicking through the composer (see RAILWAY-PUBLISH-GUIDE.md).
name: Telegram Bot Starter Kit (Python)
description: Production-ready Python Telegram bot starter: aiogram 3 webhook mode on aiohttp, secret-token validation, optional Postgres persistence, healthcheck, JSON logs, graceful shutdown. No long-polling — near-zero idle compute.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Open https://t.me/BotFather, send /newbot, follow the prompts, then paste the token here (looks like 123456789:AAH8x...).

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random secret sent by Telegram in the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header on every webhook request. The bot rejects requests without it. Auto-generated — do not change.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string over Railway's private network. Remove this variable (and the Postgres service) to run stateless with in-memory storage.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Python logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

DATABASE_URL.description: Referenced by the bot service as ${{ Postgres.DATABASE_URL }}.
